context.title: Oakland Rising Action — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements

subject.title: Oakland Mayor

positions.statement: Oakland Mayor: Barbara Lee. Barbara Lee is Moving Oakland Forward!

subject.title: Oakland Unified School District Board, District 2

positions.statement: School Board District 2: Jennifer Brouhard

subject.title: Oakland Unified School District Board, District 6

positions.statement: School Board District 6: Valarie Bachelor

subject.title: California — Proposition 1 (Authorizes Bonds for Housing Affordability Programs)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "1 YES $11.25 Billion Bond to continue building affordable homes for Californians."

subject.title: California — Proposition 2 (Increases State's Rainy Day Fund)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "2 YES Save for CA’s Future. Allow the state to deposit more money into the state's Rainy Day Fund."

subject.title: California — Proposition 3 (Provides Permanent Funding for Schools and Health Care by Extending Existing Tax on High Incomes)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "3 YES Renews an expiring tax on the top 2% wealthiest Californians to fund public education."

subject.title: California — Proposition 4 (Repeals Prohibition Against Public Funding of Election Campaigns)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "4 YES The California Fair Elections Act: Elections should be won not bought."

subject.title: California — Proposition 5 (Changes Recall Election Process for Statewide Officers)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "5 YES Election recall reform. Require a special election to fill the vacancy from a recall."

subject.title: California — Proposition 37 (Creates Loan Program for Middle-Income Buyers of Qualified New Homes)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "37 YES $25 billion in bonds to second mortgage homebuyer program."

subject.title: California — Proposition 38 (Authorizes Bonds for Immunology Medical Research)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "38 YES Immunology Research Bond that would fund research to cure and prevent diseases."

subject.title: California — Proposition 39 (Prohibits Citizens from Voting Unless They Present Government-Issued Identification)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "39 NO CA Voter Suppression Act A form of voter suppression that would make voting harder for California voters."

subject.title: California — Proposition 40 (Imposes One-Time Tax on Certain Taxpayers)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "40 YES Billionaires Tax A one time emergency 5% tax on CA billionaires to keep hospitals and ERs open."

subject.title: California — Proposition 41 (Prohibits New State Taxes That Exclude Revenues from State Spending Limit. Requires Audits for New State Special Taxes)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "41 NO Makes it harder to pass new special taxes (reducing impact of billionaires tax)."

subject.title: California — Proposition 42 (Prohibits New State Personal Property Taxes and Certain Retroactive State Taxes)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "42 NO Meant to stop the Billionaire Tax (Prop 40) and to make it harder to create a wealth tax in CA."

subject.title: California — Proposition 43 (Limits Voters' Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "43 NO Increase the threshold for special tax measures from a simple majority to a two-thirds supermajority."

subject.title: California — Proposition 44 (Requires Community Health Clinics Spend 90% Of Revenue on Program Services)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "44 NO Clinic Funding Restrictions. Could limit translation, transportation, and outreach services."

subject.title: California — Proposition 45 (Modifies Environmental Review for Certain Projects)

positions.statement: California Propositions: "45 NO Fast Track Environmental Review. Overhaul of CEQUA: CA Environmental Quality Act."

subject.title: Oakland — Measure EE (Governance Structure)

positions.statement: Oakland Measures: "EE YES Make Oakland City Hall Accountable to Oaklanders!"

subject.title: Oakland — Measure FF (Transfer Tax on Foreclosures)

positions.statement: Oakland Measures: "FF YES Close Oakland Business Tax Loophole, Fund Affordable Housing!"

subject.title: Bay Area — Regional Measure RTM (Regional Transit Measure)

positions.statement: Oakland Measures: "RTM YES Save Bay Area Transit!"
